data.name: Hotel La Compañía Casco Antiguo - The Unbound Collection by Hyatt
data.address: Av. A Calle 8, Panamá, Provincia de Panamá, Panama
data.description:
Set across 3 renovated buildings dating from the 17th to 20th centuries, this upscale hotel is a minute's walk from the Church of Saint Joseph and 6 minutes away on foot from France Square. Tocumen International Airport is 25 km away.
Featuring period details such as exposed-stone walls and wood beams, refined rooms provide smart TVs, climate control and minibars, as well as safes and Nespresso machines. Some add balconies and/or sitting areas with sofas.
The 5 dining options include an international restaurant with stained glass windows and a vaulted ceiling. There's also a stylish rooftop cocktail bar, plus a luxury spa and a rooftop pool.
